output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discontinued_net_revenue
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND p.is_active = FALSE
output.explanation: This totals net line revenue across all dates for discontinued products, counting only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue). I've assumed "discontinued" means is_active = false in the product table. Products are judged by their current status, so sales made before they were discontinued are included. Shipping fees are not included.
